newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's central bank cuts interbank daily rates.
newsitem.headline: Chile's central bank cuts interbank daily rates.

text.p: Chile's central bank on Thursday said it cut interbank daily interest rates by 0.25 percentage point in the first step toward easing the tight monetary policy in force for the past year.

The cut was the result of the "satisfactory adjustment process the economy is going through which has been shown by the favourable level of economic growth within the framework of controlled and falling inflation," said the statement.
The bank reduced the third tranche of the annual interbank daily rate to 7.25 percent from 7.5 percent, it said.
The long-awaited move is likely to be welcomed Chilean financial markets, which had been speculating that interest rates could drop.
The bank's board took the decision after a growing body of data showed the economy was on track to meet an official inflation target of 5.5 percent this year, it said.
"Examples of this are the slowdown in nominal growth of wages and the different measures of underlying inflation," it said.
